snippet.title: [LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS] Main Character CVs Revealed｜Voice Actors Confirmed for Kaito, Xion, and Liz
snippet.description:
LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS VA Revealed!

Legendary Lockpicker🧡Kaito – voiced by Yusuke Kobayashi
Leader of the Weaver Whale💖Xion – voiced by Hikaru Tono
Weaver Whale's Life of the Party💚Liz – voiced by Aimi Tanaka

✨ Meet the voice actors bringing the Breakers to life!

Anime Action RPG "LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS"
